convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for LeManSignal indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade execution logic, both external dependencies that require manual reconstruction

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal expiry
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: Historical signal scan: if BuyPosClose enabled and no direct close signal, scans historical bars from SignalBar+1 onward for a prior DnValue signal (DnValue!=0 && DnValue!=EMPTY_VALUE && UpValue==EMPTY_VALUE) to trigger BUY_Close; same logic mirrored for SELL_Close with UpValue signals
Conflicting signals cancel all actions: if both BUY_Open and SELL_Open are true simultaneously, all four trade flags (BUY_Open, SELL_Open, BUY_Close, SELL_Close) are reset to false

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input is negative for fixed lots (absolute value), positive for deposit fraction percentage. MM=-0.1 means 0.1 lots fixed size

custom_logic_notes: Signal is read from bar index SignalBar (default 1, previous bar). On new bar or when Recount is true, indicator buffers are read. UpValue on buffer 1 triggers buy open/sell close; DnValue on buffer 0 triggers sell open/buy close. When both buy and sell open signals appear simultaneously, all signals are cancelled. An extended historical scan from SignalBar+1 to end of chart looks for prior opposite close signals when no direct close signal exists and both open+close are enabled for same side. Recount flag is set on CopyBuffer failure to retry next tick. LoadHistory is called to ensure bar data availability. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen pass UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime respectively as expiry times for pending-like market order validation. The four boolean toggles (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) independently control which trade actions are permitted.
python_conversion_notes: The LeManSignal custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - check its source for the algorithm (likely a trend-following signal based on period 12). TradeAlgorithms.mqh contains BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose and GlobalVariableDel_ - these must be replaced with direct broker API calls. The MM negative/positive convention for lot sizing must be preserved. The historical bar scan for close signals (lines 116-143) is a unique feature that scans forward from SignalBar+1 looking for the first opposite signal to trigger closes - this must be carefully reimplemented. SignalBar=1 means signals are always read from the previous completed bar, not the forming bar.
